name: Mikuriya Rimu
source:
A college student who wishes to become a detective and was forcibly brought to work at the same office as the protagonist, but decided to stay and observe men for her ideal marriage. She loves puzzles and mysteries and investigating things.
She is the only virgin out of the women, and as such is quite embarrassed and thinks of the child-making business as shameless.
